about: Geometry and terrain for six marathon courses, resampled every ~50 m, for cutting synthetic training-run segments out of somewhere recognisable. Boston comes from an OpenStreetMap route relation mapped from the certified course; Chicago, New York City, Berlin, London and Tokyo are approximated by routing street-by-street through hand-placed waypoints with OSRM -- close to the real course, not the certified line. Elevation is bare-earth terrain (Mapzen merge), not a runner's barometer. Nothing here is anyone's recorded run.

sources.osm: route shapes: (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0 -- relation 11680552 for Boston; the other five routed along OpenStreetMap streets through hand-placed waypoints with OSRM
sources.elevation: Mapzen terrain merge via api.opentopodata.org: USGS NED (US, public domain), EU-DEM (Europe, Copernicus), SRTM elsewhere
